saddle-stitch.blurb: Folded sheets stapled through the fold, so it opens flat and weighs almost nothing. No spine to print on, and thin books only.

perfect-bound.blurb: Pages glued into a flat printed spine, like any trade paperback. Needs enough thickness to glue.

coil-bound.blurb: A spiral through punched holes, so the book lies perfectly flat on a table. Made for reading along and colouring in; it won't look like a trade book.

casewrap.blurb: Artwork printed straight onto the board and laminated. The keepsake format, and what a gift copy should be.

print.label: Interior printing
print.hint: How the pages are printed. The biggest lever on price for a long book.

paper.label: Paper
paper.hint: What the pages are printed on.

premium-colour.label: Premium colour
premium-colour.hint: Richest colour and the sharpest registration. What illustrated pages are worth, and the provider's own pick for children's books.

standard-colour.label: Standard colour
standard-colour.hint: Colour on every page at about a third of the premium price per page. Colours read a little flatter.

premium-bw.label: Premium black & white
premium-bw.hint: Deep blacks and fine greys for pencil and ink work. Illustrations print as monochrome.

standard-bw.label: Standard black & white
standard-bw.hint: The cheapest way to print a long book. Right for text-led chapter books, wrong for colour art.

80-coated-white.label: 80# coated white
80-coated-white.hint: Heavy and smooth with a slight sheen, so colours pop. The provider's recommendation for picture books.

60-uncoated-white.label: 60# uncoated white
60-uncoated-white.hint: Lighter and matte, more like a novel. Softer colour, thinner and cheaper book.

60-uncoated-cream.label: 60# uncoated cream
60-uncoated-cream.hint: Warm off-white that is gentler to read against. Black & white interiors only — the provider prints no colour on cream.

gloss.label: Gloss
gloss.hint: Shiny and saturated, and wipes clean — which matters for a book toddlers hold. Shows fingerprints.

matte.label: Matte
matte.hint: Soft, low-glare and reads as more premium. Marks show more easily than gloss.

footer.tagline: Write, illustrate, and print personalized children's picture books with AI.

hero.title: Turn a story into a printed picture book.
hero.subtitle: Write your tale, design recurring characters and places, and let AI illustrate every page with a consistent look — then order a beautiful, print-ready book delivered to your door.
hero.note: Free to start — no account or credit card needed.

trust.3: Free to start — no credit card

how.heading: From blank page to bookshelf in three steps
how.subhead: A guided flow takes you from an idea to a finished, printable book — no design skills required.

step1.title: Write your story
step1.body: Paste or write your tale. We analyze it into characters, places, and a page-by-page screenplay you can fine-tune.

step2.title: Illustrate with AI
step2.body: Design your references once. Every page reuses them, so your cast stays visually consistent from cover to cover.

step3.title: Print & keep
step3.body: Lay out text and art, then order a full-bleed, print-ready book — or get it instantly as a digital edition.

features.heading: Everything you need to make a real book
features.subhead: Powerful tools under a simple, playful surface — so the story stays the star.

0.title: Consistent characters
0.body: Design a character or place once and it stays on-model across every page — same face, outfit, and style.

1.title: Per-page AI art
1.body: Each page is illustrated to match your story beat, in an art style you choose and can refine.

2.title: Print-ready export
2.body: We compose full-bleed, correctly-sized pages and hand off a print-ready book for real fulfillment.

3.title: Digital edition included
3.body: Get your finished book as a beautiful PDF too — read it on any device, keep it forever.

4.title: Guest-first, zero setup
4.body: Start creating immediately — no sign-up wall. Save and print whenever you're ready.

5.title: Sparks that roll over
5.body: Paid plans include a monthly bundle of generation credits that carry over, plus cheaper prints.

founder.quote: When my toddler needed surgery, I couldn't find a single picture book gentle enough to help him understand what was about to happen. So I made one myself — and that book became Childbook Studio.
